filename: ExoTST_ Exogenous-Aware Temporal Sequence Transformer for Time Series Prediction.pdf
title: ExoTST: Exogenous-Aware Temporal Sequence Transformer for Time Series Prediction
testbed_rationale: The study uses site-level eddy covariance and reanalysis data to benchmark a generic multivariate time series architecture rather than releasing a standardized climate parameterization testbed.
pain_points: Integrating current/projected exogenous drivers alongside past context is challenging in traditional autoregressive or pure forward models.
Real-world exogenous driver time series often have missing values and temporal misalignment.
Noisy future or projected exogenous variables degrade model performance.
Distribution shifts between historical and current/projected exogenous series.
extraction_notes: Authors Arvind Renganathan and Vipin Kumar were supported by NSF LEAP STC award 2019625. The manuscript was published as an arXiv preprint in October 2024.
